g.text: bot refresh --prices --only-missing, hourly
the ticker is left out, no request [--only-missing and it already has a price]
the ticker is listed [no --only-missing, or no price yet]
the ticker is skipped, no request [its newest bar is on or after the last weekday before today]
the ticker is queued [no bar yet, or an older newest bar]

text.tspan: the ticker and every later one are deferred, not failed [the rate limit is hit, by this or an earlier ticker]
the rest skip the request; deferred tickers are left out of the failure rate; daily.sh runs another round if this one succeeded

the bars are stored without market cap [the newest bar is more than 7 days old]

the ticker and every later one are deferred, not failed [the shares lookup hits the rate limit]
